race.comment: CLEAR PROOF (1) rewarded for his consistency fourth up with a dominant victory over 1250m at Canterbury in this grade. Should handle the weight increase from the low draw and races best with the sting out of the ground. Leading contender. LET'S GO AGAIN (12) kicked off this campaign with a solid win two runs back at Kembla Grange. Sent to town with a fighting on pace fourth over 1100m at this track in a strong rating contest. Proven at the trip and gets the benefit of Grima's claim again. Maps well and will feature prominently. TWINKLING STAR (15) sent to town at her second run back and turned a tidy effort when she closed late to run fifth over 1100m here. Has the upside to finish closer. LONG LEGS (2) went down the Oaks path last campaign. Short of her best trip here, though she's classy and a forward showing is anticipated.
